purpose.zh: 练单腿站时骨盆左右不歪的控制
purpose.en: Train control to keep your pelvis level while standing on one leg.

text.zh: 支撑腿站稳，另一侧骨盆慢慢提起
text.en: Stand firm on one leg and slowly lift the other hip

text.zh: 轻扶椅子，抬起的膝盖一直弯着。
text.en: Hold the chair lightly and keep the lifted knee bent.

text.zh: 小幅度提起再放平，上身别侧弯。
text.en: Lift a little, lower to level, and keep your trunk upright.

commonErrors.en: Leaning the trunk instead of lifting the hip.

commonErrors.zh: 支撑腿膝盖一弯一直地借力
commonErrors.en: Bending and straightening the standing knee to help.

cautions.zh: 刚开始时每侧先做 1 组 4 次，幅度小一点
cautions.en: When starting out, do one set of four per side in a small range.

cautions.zh: 腰、髋或膝盖疼，或站不稳时就停
cautions.en: If your back, hip or knee hurts or you feel unsteady, stop.

changes: 节奏按 spec 时间轴手算（派生值把 90% 以上都算停顿，和 spec 不符）：提 1.5/停 1.5/放 3.0/歇 2.0 s（派生 0.9/2.4/1.8/3.0）
caution 拆成两条「X 时 Y」短句；error 去「屈伸」
EN 口令 Hitch up → Lift your hip
